brief:
Palestinian-Chilean singer Elyanna has drawn criticism for using prison visuals as a backdrop in her "BOSA" music video, Middle East Eye reported. Viewers questioned her artistic decision to employ jail imagery given the documented reality of Palestinian women currently held in Israeli detention facilities.

The backlash highlights broader concerns about how artists deploy incarceration as an aesthetic element in their work. Critics argue that using prison settings as a visual motif carries particular weight when such detention remains an active and pressing humanitarian issue affecting Palestinians, especially women in the custody of Israeli authorities.

title: Palestinian-Chilean singer Elyanna criticized for prison imagery in music video
